summary: A mixed day driven by regulatory changes affecting retail (gold hallmarking fees up 67%) and fintech (UPI MDR norms from October 15), alongside Reliance's $1.3 billion rupee bond issuance and Fed rate decision impacts on Indian markets.

bullets.text: BIS raised gold hallmarking fees by 67%, effective immediately on gold and silver jewellery articles.
Government introduces 0.4% UPI MDR fee on merchant transfers exceeding Rs 2,000 effective October 15; P2P transactions exempted.
Reliance to raise $1.3 billion in first rupee bond sale since 2023.
Gold imports contracted to $2.3 billion in August following customs duty hike; silver imports rose sharply.
Sensex gained 333 points and Nifty rose 99 points on September 16 after Tuesday sell-off; Fed decision expected today.
